name: star-hept
comment: THE 7-FOLD FAMILY, which no palette in this repo could express before. D=840 is the point: every interior angle has to be an integer multiple of 2pi/D, and 7 does not divide the 120 every other spherical palette uses, so a heptagram's 540/7 = 77.142857 degrees lands nowhere on that grid. At 840 the unit is 3/7 of a degree and the whole family is integral — {3} 140, {4} 210, {7} 300, {7/2} 180, {7/3} 60. A larger D costs nothing: the search branches over CORNER CLASSES, not over D. Five tiles and no 5-fold ones, deliberately: no finite rotation group contains both a 5-fold and a 7-fold axis, so mixing them can only produce words that never close. Everything 7-fold on the sphere is DIHEDRAL — prisms, antiprisms and, above k=1, the pyramids: the {7/2} pyramid closes at rho=100.487 with apex density 2, the {7/3} at rho=118.291 with apex density 3, which is why maxDensity is 3 and not 2.
